## What changed

Tell the story: what you did, what the owner will see, why it matters.

## How to try it

One to three numbered steps the owner can follow in the running app, ending with what
they should see. For example:

1. Open Manage projects.
2. Press Add a pasted project and paste a status.
3. You land on its card, labelled pasted.

If the change has nothing to try, such as a document or a configuration change, write
"Nothing to try:" and say why.

Keep this heading exactly as written: tools may read this section from merged pull
requests and find it by its heading.

## Roadmap and changelog

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased for this change
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` Now line removed or updated
- [ ] No deploy-sensitive file changed (or this PR is titled as such and changes nothing else)
